phase_scope: Developer-preview work: installable local distribution, a model-neutral agent bridge, separately evidenced Claude Code and Codex integrations, and private release-candidate validation.
active_objective: After the required principal release decisions are recorded, assemble and externally test a private v0.2 developer-preview candidate from the exact packed artifact in an unfamiliar source-free consumer repository.
non_goals: No npm publication, public repository, public release, visibility change, production installation, or customer deployment
No license text, contribution policy, release name, trademark claim, or publication date inferred without a principal decision
No claim that partial Claude or Codex assurance is full enforcement
No hiding of provider-specific uncontrolled capability routes
No source-checkout import, private evidence dependency, or institutional knowledge in the consumer quickstart
No removal of known-failing fixtures, public verifier capability, or independently useful free functionality
No change to S0-S9 runtime semantics or the frozen effect taxonomy
No queue entries outside the authorized Developer Preview Macro Delta

exit_contracts.statement: The replay-equivalence harness fails on injected divergence.
exit_contracts.verifies_via: Property-based synthetic workflows and injected effect-leak fixtures

exit_contracts.statement: The untrusted-data containment harness fails on injected instruction leakage.
exit_contracts.verifies_via: Injected instruction-leak fixtures and clean containment controls

exit_contracts.statement: Both conformance harnesses are wired as the release gate.
exit_contracts.verifies_via: npm test and repository release-gate configuration

exit_contracts.statement: Effect category types are frozen and exported.
The pure generator performs no input or output under lockdown.
The execution loop yields, fulfills, and seals effects.
ACT replay suppression is enforced with idempotency keys.
The dCBOR envelope encodes deterministically across runtimes.
The hash chain seals and verifies.
exit_contracts.verifies_via: Seal, verify, mutation, and truncation fixtures

exit_contracts.statement: The append-only file adapter satisfies the persistence port.
Content addressing separates blobs from the chain.
Schema and kernel versions are pinned per record.
Slice lock and allowed-path enforcement block writes at the tool-call boundary.
The verification gate executes real commands and rejects asserted success.
The stop-condition evaluator returns a checkable state.
The gate definition is immutable without a principal DECISION.
The orientation call returns compact status.
Denials carry the allowed set and amendment path.
The rotation state file permits cold resume.
The reconstructability score computes from journal completeness.
Observe mode journals without enforcing.
Declared-versus-observed gaps are reported as findings.
Coverage distinguishes not observed from not present.
The signing layer carries an algorithm identifier per record.
Device key classes are recorded and never overstated.
External timestamp anchoring is optional and verifiable.
INFER records pin provider, snapshot, prompt hash, and parameters.
Effect categories map to CASE Action, Identity, Tool, and Relationship.
Export validates against the CASE context.
A local SCOPA package installs in a clean repository without monorepo-relative resolution.
exit_contracts.verifies_via: Packed-artifact installation in a fresh temporary repository
